solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Recieve'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Receive'.**
 
• The word '**Receive**' is a **verb** which means 'to get or be given something'. **(प्राप्त करना)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• I received a gift from my friend on my birthday.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Recieve'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Thief -** a person who steals another person's property, especially by stealth and without using force **(चोर)**
 
• **Believe - **accept (something) as true; feel sure of the truth of **(विश्वास करना)**
 
• **Relief -** a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress **(राहत)**
